title: CPF Module Schema: SQL Managed Database module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-mssqlmanageddatabase'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

long_term_retention_policies.type: map(object({ weekly_retention = string monthly_retention = string yearly_retention = string week_of_year = number }))
long_term_retention_policies.description: (Optional) Map containing long_term_retention_policy for this Managed Database object({ weekly_retention = "(Optional) The weekly retention policy for an LTR backup in an ISO 8601 format. Valid value is between 1 to 520 weeks. e.g. P1Y, P1M, P1W or P7D" monthly_retention = "(Optional) The monthly retention policy for an LTR backup in an ISO 8601 format. Valid value is between 1 to 120 months. e.g. P1Y, P1M, P4W or P30D" yearly_retention = "(Optional) The yearly retention policy for an LTR backup in an ISO 8601 format. Valid value is between 1 to 10 years. e.g. P1Y, P12M, P52W or P365D." week_of_year = "(Optional) The week of year to take the yearly backup. Value has to be between 1 and 52." })

managed_instance_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Managed Instance.

name.description: (Optional) Provide a custom name for the managed SQL database. If not set, a name will be generated.

retention_days.description: (Optional) Specifies the short term retention policy - retention days for the new databases.

retention_policy.description: (Optional) Should retention policy be applied or skip as per input.

id.description: The ID of the SQL Managed Database

name.description: The name of the SQL Managed Database

resource.description: The Azure SQL Managed Database Resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Mssqlmanageddatabase' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
